verdict: Nvidia's revenue jumped 73% to a record $68.1B as Data Center sales hit $62.3B — and $5.5B of gains on its investment stakes helped lift net income to $43.0B.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: AI data-center platforms; a record $62.3B, up 75% YoY and 91% of total revenue. Within it, compute was $51.3B (+58%) and networking a record $11.0B (+263%) on NVLink fabric for GB200 and GB300 systems.

segments.name: Edge Computing
segments.note: Gaming ($3.7B, +47%), professional visualization ($1.3B, +159%), automotive ($604M) and OEM and other ($161M); up 55% YoY in total.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: R&D spending on new chips and platforms like Vera Rubin; up 48% YoY as Nvidia hires and builds faster.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Sales and admin costs; up 31% YoY, growing far slower than revenue.

otherDetail: Interest income of $568M, plus $5,604M of other income — mostly $5,491M of gains on stakes Nvidia holds in other companies — less $74M of interest expense.
follow100Note: The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Data Center sets another record
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue was a record $62.3B — 91 cents of every revenue dollar. Networking revenue nearly quadrupled to $11.0B (+263%) as NVLink fabrics for GB200/GB300 systems ramped, and hyperscalers were slightly over half of Data Center sales.

takeaways.title: Investment gains padded the bottom line
takeaways.text: Gains on stakes Nvidia holds in other companies added $5.5B to other income. That is the main reason GAAP net income ($43.0B) came in above non-GAAP ($39.6B) — the gap is paper gains, not chip sales.

takeaways.title: Cash generation stayed enormous
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $36.2B in the single quarter. Across fiscal 2026 Nvidia returned $41.1B to shareholders in buybacks and dividends, and still had $58.5B of buyback authorization left.

oneTimers: Gains on equity securities of $5,491M (mostly unrealized) sit inside GAAP other income and are excluded from non-GAAP results — the main reason GAAP net income of $42,960M tops non-GAAP net income of $39,552M.
